title: ITE WSDip
line: A multi-role platform for ITE's Work-Study Diploma.
problem: ITE Work-Study Diploma (WSDip) is a multi-role education management platform supporting trainees, trainers, administrators and company representatives. Each type of user needs to see different information from the same system.
did: As a Full-stack Developer, I built features that improved both the user experience and backend reliability. My work involved developing responsive UI with custom ShadCN components, integrating backend APIs and managing data flow across the different user types. I also handled debugging and supported deployments using Docker, Azure Blob Storage and UNIX environments.
outcome: A more reliable platform for everyone who uses it, from trainees to partner companies.

story.title: The Challenge
story.body:
ITE Work-Study Diploma (WSDip) is a multi-role education management platform that supports trainees, trainers, administrators and company representatives. All four types of users share one system, but each of them needs to see different information.

Keeping the platform clear and reliable for all of them was the main challenge.

story.title: What I Did
story.body: During my internship at Amber Creative, I contributed as a Full-stack Developer, developing responsive UI with custom ShadCN components, integrating backend APIs and managing the data flow across the different user types. I also handled debugging, dynamic data handling and supported deployments of new versions of the platform.

image.alt: The ITE Work-Study Diploma sign-in page

story.title: The Tools
story.body: The platform is built with Next.js, React and TypeScript, using ShadCN and Tailwind CSS for the interface. Behind the scenes, it uses Zustand, Azure Blob Storage, Docker, Node.js and Swagger UI, deployed in UNIX environments.

story.title: The Result
story.body: A more reliable platform for everyone who uses it, from trainees and trainers to administrators and partner companies.
